product_overview: AXZY CHECK Residenciales is a residential complex management platform with a web admin dashboard and an offline-capable mobile app for guards and operational staff. It centralizes residents, properties, payments, incidents, rounds, accesses, schedules, and reporting behind a JWT-secured API.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication and role-based access control for ADMIN, LIDER, SHIFT, GUARD, MAINT, and RESDN users.
Enable admins to manage residents, houses/properties, fees, payments, users, and operational records from the web app.
Support guard and maintenance workflows in the mobile app, including offline capture and later synchronization.
Record and track incidents, visitor passes, rounds, assignments, and maintenance activities with auditable history.
Generate operational dashboards, datatables, summaries, and downloadable payment receipts.
Keep user-facing content in Spanish and maintain consistent UI behavior through the shared component system.

features.name: Autenticación y control de acceso
features.description: Permite iniciar sesión, persistir la sesión con JWT, aplicar redirección por rol y cerrar sesión de forma segura.
user_flows: POST /users/login with valid admin credentials -> Receive 200 with JWT token and user data -> Store token in auth state and persist to localStorage -> Navigate to /#/ and load protected dashboard
POST /users/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 with error messages -> Show login error and keep user on /#/login
GET protected route with valid Authorization: Bearer <jwt> -> Receive 200 and protected data -> Access the requested module based on role
POST /users/logout with valid token -> Receive 200 -> Clear auth state and persisted token -> Redirect to /#/login
GET protected route with expired or missing token -> Receive 401 or 403 -> Force logout or redirect to /#/login with error toast

features.name: Panel principal y métricas operativas
features.description: Muestra indicadores clave, navegación por módulos, listas recientes y vistas analíticas para supervisión diaria.
user_flows: GET /home/stats with valid token -> Receive 200 with KPI data -> Render the 5 dashboard cards and recent activity lists on /#/
GET /home/stats with valid token -> Receive 200 -> Switch to analytics tab -> Render chart-based operational analytics
GET /home/stats with valid token -> Receive 200 -> Switch theme using the floating color picker -> Update CSS variables for the dashboard palette
GET /home/stats without token -> Receive 401 -> Show error toast and prevent dashboard rendering

features.name: Usuarios y roles
features.description: Gestiona el alta, consulta, edición, cambio de contraseña y restablecimiento de usuarios del sistema.
user_flows: POST /users/datatable with page, limit, filters.role='GUARD', filters.active=true, and valid token -> Receive 200 with paginated guard rows -> Display filtered user list
POST /users/datatable with malformed filters -> Receive 400 with validation errors -> Show error state in the users table
GET /users/:id with valid token -> Receive 200 with user details -> Open user detail or edit flow
POST /users/:id/password with current and new password -> Receive 200 -> Confirm password changed and keep session valid
POST /users/:id/reset-password with admin token -> Receive 200 -> Allow the user to sign in with the new temporary password
DELETE /users/:id with non-admin or unauthorized role -> Receive 403 -> Show access denied message

features.name: Residentes y casas/properties
features.description: Administra residentes, su relación con una casa, sus contactos y la desactivación en cascada de la cuenta asociada.
user_flows: POST /residents/datatable with filters and valid token -> Receive 200 with resident rows -> Show resident list and detail links
POST /residents with valid resident data linked to an existing house -> Receive 201 or 200 with created resident -> Display the new resident in the datatable
PUT /residents/:id with updated resident data -> Receive 200 -> Refresh resident detail page and related contacts
DELETE /residents/:id with valid admin token -> Receive 200 -> Deactivate resident and related user in a single transaction -> Confirm linked user.active becomes false
POST /residents/datatable with invalid house or validation error -> Receive 400 -> Display form or table error message
POST /houses/datatable with page, limit, filters, and valid token -> Receive 200 with house rows -> Render properties page data using the House model

features.name: Cuotas y pagos
features.description: Permite crear cuotas, asignarlas a residentes, registrar pagos, consultar resúmenes y descargar recibos PDF.
user_flows: POST /payments/fees/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with fee rows -> List ONE_TIME and MONTHLY fee templates
POST /fees with ONE_TIME fee data and dueDate -> Receive 200/201 -> Save the fee and make it available for assignment
POST /fees with MONTHLY fee data without dueDate -> Receive 200/201 -> Save recurring fee template
POST /payments/datatable with resident, status, period, and fee filters -> Receive 200 with payment rows -> Show filtered payment history
POST /payments with valid payment data -> Receive 200/201 -> Create payment record -> Refresh payment list and summary cards
POST /payments/summary with valid token -> Receive 200 with aggregated totals -> Show payment summary cards
GET /payments/receipt/:id/download with valid token -> Receive 200 with application/pdf stream -> Download receipt file
POST /payments with invalid fee status or missing required dueDate for ONE_TIME fee -> Receive 400 -> Display validation error
POST /payments/fees/bulk-assign or bulk assignment dialog action with many residents -> Receive 200 -> Create multiple resident-fee assignments

features.name: Incidencias y notificaciones
features.description: Registra incidencias, muestra su detalle y soporta actualización rápida con notificaciones internas y externas.
user_flows: POST /incidents/datatable with category, type, status, date range, and assignedTo filters -> Receive 200 with incident rows -> Render the incidents board
POST /incidents with valid incident payload -> Receive 201/200 immediately -> Show the new incident in the list without waiting for side effects
POST /incidents with required fields missing -> Receive 400 with validation errors -> Keep the incident form open and display messages
GET /incidents/:id with valid token -> Receive 200 with incident detail and timeline -> Open IncidentDetailDialog
PUT /incidents/:id with status change to ATTENDED -> Receive 200 -> Move incident from pending to attended tab

POST /incidents with valid token but server-side notification failure -> Receive 200/201 for the incident creation -> Show success to user while asynchronous Resend/WhatsApp processing continues separately

features.name: Accesos y pases
features.description: Gestiona pases temporales, recurrentes, de entrega y de servicio, así como su ciclo de estados.
user_flows: POST /accesses/datatable with filters and valid token -> Receive 200 with access rows -> Display passes by status and type
GET /accesses/types with valid token -> Receive 200 with available access types -> Populate access creation form
GET /accesses/statuses with valid token -> Receive 200 with available status options -> Populate filters and badges
POST /accesses with valid temporary pass data -> Receive 201/200 -> Create pass in PENDING status -> Show it in the access list
PUT /accesses/:id after first gate scan -> Receive 200 -> Move pass from PENDING to ACTIVE
PUT /accesses/:id after window expires -> Receive 200 -> Update pass to FINISHED or EXPIRED
POST /accesses with invalid date window or missing visitor data -> Receive 400 -> Show validation error in the form

features.name: Rondas, ubicaciones y escaneo
features.description: Soporta la gestión de rondas, las ubicaciones de control y el registro de escaneos en campo.
user_flows: POST /rounds/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with round rows -> Show today's rounds and statuses
GET /rounds/:id with valid token -> Receive 200 with round detail and scanned locations -> Open round detail page
POST /rounds with valid data -> Receive 201/200 -> Create a new round for guard operations
POST /rounds/:id/scans with location scan payload -> Receive 200 -> Append scan to the round timeline
POST /rounds/:id/scans with invalid location or duplicate scan -> Receive 400 or 409 -> Show error message and prevent duplicate recording
POST /locations/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with location rows -> Use locations as round checkpoints

features.name: Asignaciones y mantenimiento
features.description: Permite revisar hallazgos operativos y convertirlos en trabajos de mantenimiento o seguimiento.
user_flows: POST /maintenance/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with maintenance rows -> Display maintenance records
POST /assignments with valid data from a round finding -> Receive 201/200 -> Create assignment in PENDING status
PUT /assignments/:id with status CHECKING -> Receive 200 -> Update progress for maintenance workflow
PUT /assignments/:id with status UNDER_REVIEW -> Receive 200 -> Continue review workflow
PUT /assignments/:id with status REVIEWED or ANOMALY -> Receive 200 -> Close or flag the assignment
POST /assignments with invalid assignee or missing required fields -> Receive 400 -> Show validation error

features.name: Kardex e inventario
features.description: Administra movimientos de inventario y consulta el historial de entradas y salidas.
user_flows: POST /kardex/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with inventory movement rows -> Render the kardex table
POST /kardex with valid movement data -> Receive 201/200 -> Record inventory movement and refresh totals
PUT /kardex/:id with corrected movement data -> Receive 200 -> Update the existing movement record
DELETE /kardex/:id with unauthorized token -> Receive 403 -> Block the deletion and show access denied
POST /kardex/datatable with invalid pagination or filters -> Receive 400 -> Show table error state

features.name: Horarios y configuración operativa
features.description: Gestiona horarios de trabajo, configuraciones de ronda y catálogos operativos usados por el personal.
user_flows: POST /schedules/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with schedule rows -> Render shift schedules
POST /schedules with valid data -> Receive 201/200 -> Create a new work schedule
PUT /schedules/:id with updated times -> Receive 200 -> Update schedule details
POST /catalog/maintenance-categories with valid token -> Receive 200 with lookup values -> Populate maintenance forms
GET /catalog/:key with a valid catalog key -> Receive 200 -> Load lookup data for selects and filters
POST /schedules with invalid time range -> Receive 400 -> Show schedule validation error

features.name: Reportes y métricas agregadas
features.description: Genera métricas consolidadas para supervisión y análisis administrativo.
user_flows: GET /reports with valid token -> Receive 200 with aggregated metrics -> Show report dashboard
GET /reports with insufficient role permissions -> Receive 403 -> Hide restricted report data and show error toast
GET /reports with valid token but empty dataset -> Receive 200 with zeroed metrics -> Render empty-state reporting view
POST /reports/export with supported format request -> Receive 200 or 501 depending on implementation -> Trigger export flow or show planned-feature message

features.name: Clientes, zonas, ubicaciones y configuración
features.description: Administra entidades base del complejo residencial, incluyendo clientes, zonas y ubicaciones.
user_flows: POST /clients/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with client rows -> Display residential complex list
POST /clients with valid data -> Receive 201/200 -> Create a new client record
POST /zones/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with zone rows -> Show zone list for the selected client
POST /locations/datatable with valid token -> Receive 200 with location rows -> Show location list for route and round setup
DELETE /clients/:id with valid token -> Receive 200 -> Soft-delete the client and preserve history
POST /zones with invalid client reference -> Receive 400 -> Show validation error and prevent creation

api_client.auth: Authorization: Bearer <token> from Redux auth slice

list: residents      (ResidentsPage, ResidentDetailPage, ContactsPage, ResidentForm, ResidentContactsDialog, ResidentQuickAccessDialog)
payments       (PaymentsPage, FeesPage, PaymentReceiptPage, PaymentFormDialog, BulkAssignFeeDialog, PaymentSummaryCards)

authentication: JWT token storage in Redux + localStorage (redux-persist)
Route guards by role (ADMIN, LIDER, SHIFT, RESDN)
dashboard: HomePage with 5 KPI cards (Residentes, Cuotas vencidas, Pases activos, Guardias, Incidencias pendientes)
datatables: 14+ pages use this pattern (users, residents, properties, payments, fees, accesses, incidents, kardex, maintenances, rounds, schedules, locations, guards, complaints)
payments: List payments with filters (resident, status, period, fee)
Bulk assign fees to many residents at once
incidents: Real-time updates on creation (Resend email + WhatsApp fired server-side)

incidents.Filters: category, type, status, date range, assignedTo

users: Server-side datatable with role + active filters
theme: ITThemeProvider injects CSS vars on document.documentElement.style
--color-primary-50 to --color-primary-900 for primary, secondary, ternary, danger, success, info, alert, warning
useITTheme() hook; useITThemeSafe() returns undefined outside provider
i18n: All entity names in Spanish (Residente, Cuota, Pago, etc.)
offline_first: N/A (WEB is online-only; offline-first is APP concern)
theming_components: ITCard, ITButton, ITBadget, ITDataTable, ITInput, ITFormBuilder, ITTable, ITTabs, ITDialog, ITDatePicker, ITTimePicker, ITToast, ITLoader, ITNavbar, ITSidebar, ITSlideToggle, ITStepper, ITSearchSelect, ITSelect, ITTripleFilter, ITDropfile, ITImage, ITLayout, ITText, ITCalendar, ITPagination

standard_response.shape: { success: boolean, data: <T> | { rows: T[], total: number }, messages: string[] }

datatable_request.sort: Array of objects with field=string, dir=asc|desc
